description: Pure-compression nominal strength Po and the tied design axial cap phi*Pn,max.

tolerance.rationale: closed form. DB20 area pi*20^2/4/100 = 3.14159 cm2 (engine uses REBAR table round(...,2) = 3.14 -> expect a ~1e-3 relative offset in Ast; flagged, not slack).

notes: The engine's Ab comes from REBAR['DB20']['area'] = round(pi*400/4, 2) = 314.16 mm2; this reference uses the unrounded pi*d^2/4. Difference is the rounding only.

description: Pure-tension capacity Pnt = -fy*Ast and its design value phi*Pnt (phi = 0.90).

expected.note: Independent strain-compatibility reference supplied in EV-06: tests/validation/reference/reference_column_ev06.py (pm_point / pm_curve, math-only, no production import). The engine's _calculate_pm_curve reproduces it to rel < 1e-12 at all 46 curve points; balanced point + force equilibrium verified. Run tests/validation/run_ev06_column.py phase E.

intermediate.why_blocked: An interior P-M point needs an independent strain-compatibility solver (layer/fibre integration). Building one and trusting it as a REFERENCE requires its own verification (hand-checked balanced point, published interaction chart, or a second tool). Per the EV-02 brief this is marked BLOCKED rather than fabricated. Anchors EV-COL-001/002 are delivered; the full curve is EV-03 scope.

notes: UNBLOCKED in EV-06. BLOCKED - not skipped-to-hide; genuinely no trustworthy independent value at EV-02.
